thread.title: Qorvo Surges 10%: Sees Apple Gains Later This Year - Barron's

title: Qorvo Surges 10%: Sees Apple Gains Later This Year - Barron's
text:
Large 
[Updates with stock price change after-hours at bottom of post.] 
With shares of Qorvo ( QRVO ) rebounding after a disappointing forecast this afternoon, some investors may be agreeing with Cody Acree of Drexel Hamilton , who thinks bad news is already in the share price. 
Qorvo stock initially traded lower after it reported fiscal Q3 results that topped analysts’ expectations, but offered an outlook for this quarter’s revenue 16% lower than consensus. 
The stock has bounced back, now up 12 cents, or 2.5%, at $4.90. 
Qorvo management pointed to weakening handset sales, and the immediate implication is the outlook is affected by Qorvo’s biggest customer, Apple ( AAPL ), about whom analysts continue to ratchet lower their expectations for March-quarter iPhone sales. 
And that’s the conclusion of Acree, who has a Buy rating on Qorvo stock, and a $95 price target. 
He writes that “the company blamed the soft guidance on weakness in the handset market, undoubtedly at its largest customer Apple and the lighter than expected sell-through of its recently launched models." 
But this is now a bit of old news, he suggests: 
With Apple’s softer holiday sell-through being well reported over the past several weeks and QRVO’s stock already having declined about 20% from its highs in November, investors look to have already largely factored in QRVO’s lighter guidance, with the company’s shares remaining relatively flat in after-hours trading. 
And there’s lots else here to like for Qorvo, he writes: 
Also likely helping to support QRVO’s share price is its indication of “recent developments with mid/high-band PADs and Phase 6 design wins”, which include mid/high-band and low-band integrated PAD modules. The company also sampled a custom mid/high-band PAD to an additional tier-one smartphone OEM. These mid/high-band PAD are significant as it has been the lack of high-performance BAW filter shipments that have recently weighed on its gross margins, particularly as it previously earned a high volume low-band PAD design with its largest customer that used SAW filters instead of the firm’s BAW designs. 
Update : The stock has now staged quite an impressive turnaround, surging by $6.43, or almost 9%, at $78.20, and at one point almost 10% higher this evening. 
One thing that may be helping the company are remarks by management on the call that later this year, it expects to see the biggest-ever content gains in Apple products that it has ever seen for its wireless parts. Most Popular
